systems.name: string - system name matching runs key
systems.queries_ranked: int - total queries in this run
systems.ci_95_lower: float - lower bound of 95% bootstrap CI for MRR@10
systems.ci_95_upper: float - upper bound of 95% bootstrap CI for MRR@10

cross_tool_validation.custom_mrr: float - MRR from fixed custom eval script
cross_tool_validation.trec_eval_mrr: float - MRR from compiled trec_eval tool

audit_report_schema._notes: systems sorted by mrr_at_10 descending; include all C(4,2)=6 pairwise comparisons
